turn_text: Hi there and welcome to the Manufacturing Report for the week of April 10. I'm Scott Paul, President of the Alliance for American Manufacturing and host of this podcast. Everything from manhole covers on sewers to the water pipes that bring drinking water to our homes are made in America.
